epistemic_assessments.rationale: Sequenced from the reconstructions, dispositions and evolution projections in this run; the phase ordering is the pack's default and its preconditions are drawn from the evidence, not asserted.

payload.objective: Let existing forums consume shared evidence where it is proven, changing no mandate.
payload.new_substrate_capability: Single evidence assembly at one cut-off date, consumed by both forums; shared model evidence supplied once to both assurance functions.
preconditions: Shadow complete for the conformance assessment
A single cut-off date agreed that satisfies both forums
Confirmation that shared assembly does not reduce what the second line sees
success_evidence: Preparation effort reduced from the 6 person-day baseline
Both forums assessing the same change against the same evidence vintage
No reduction in the substance or volume of second-line challenge
payload.stop_condition: Stop if the second-line forum reports seeing less than before, or if challenge falls after the change.
payload.next_phase_gate: Reuse complete when two cycles run on shared assembly with challenge unchanged.

required_authority: Each step is a proposal. Entering any phase requires an authorised organisational decision, and this projection neither schedules nor commits anything.
caveat: Phases may be entered per forum rather than across the estate. A design authority at NUDGE and a complaints forum at OBSERVE is a normal plan.
prohibited_inference: That any step is scheduled, approved or committed
That the sequence must be applied estate-wide in lockstep
